## D1. Organisers: pearl timings are changing on the ladder, and replays will hide them (from 9pm AEST 27 Sep = 11:00 UTC 27 Sep)
**What it is.** From tonight, scrim replays no longer include pearl timing, maps may have look-alike variants with completely different pearl timings, and existing maps' pearl distributions may change a lot. It applies to **all scrims**, not just autoscrims. Anything we tuned to the ladder maps' pearl schedules, or any analysis that reads pearl timings from replays (our study/replay tooling, the fast-pearl-tile / dead-end pocket findings in briefing.md lines 22-43), will stop matching or stop being possible for games after the change. Our ladder results may shift for reasons unrelated to our bot.
